one-side-only.label: Operation done to one side of the equation only.
one-side-only.feedback: You changed the {side} side but not the other.
one-side-only.hint: Remember an equation is like a balance scale, what you do to one side, you must do to the other side.

wrong-inverse.label: Used the same operation instead of the inverse operation.
wrong-inverse.feedback: You used the same operation that is already in the equation instead of its inverse operation.
wrong-inverse.hint: What is being done to {variable}? Check the sign in front of the number, then use the inverse operation.

wrong-order.label: Undid the operations in the wrong order.
wrong-order.feedback: You undid the operations in the wrong order. Undo addition and subtraction before multiplication and division, unless the whole side is divided.
wrong-order.hint: Which operation was done to {variable} last? That's the one to undo first.

treats-coefficient-as-term.label: Treated the coefficient as a number being added or subtracted.
treats-coefficient-as-term.feedback: The coefficient is multiplying or dividing {variable}, not being added or subtracted.
treats-coefficient-as-term.hint: In 4x, the coefficient 4 multiplies x, and in x/6, x is divided by 6. What inverse operation undoes that?

not-reciprocal.label: Multiplied by the fraction instead of its reciprocal.
not-reciprocal.feedback: Multiplying by the same fraction changes the coefficient instead of undoing it.
not-reciprocal.hint: What number can you multiply a fraction by to get 1?

denominator-only.label: Undid only the denominator of the coefficient.
denominator-only.feedback: You undid the denominator, but the numerator is still multiplying {variable}.
denominator-only.hint: A fractional coefficient has two parts. Can you undo both in one step?

numerator-only.label: Undid only the numerator of the coefficient.
numerator-only.feedback: You undid the numerator, but {variable} is still being divided by the denominator.
numerator-only.hint: A fractional coefficient has two parts. Can you undo both in one step?

reversed-order.label: Subtracted or divided in the wrong order.
reversed-order.feedback: You chose the correct inverse operation, but the numbers are in the wrong order.
reversed-order.hint: Start with the number that is already alone on its side, then apply the operation to it.

integer-sign-error.label: Correct value with the wrong sign.
integer-sign-error.feedback: Your number is right, but the sign is not.
integer-sign-error.hint: Check the sign of the number or coefficient you used, and the sign rules for negatives.

integer-arithmetic-error.label: Arithmetic error with negative numbers.
integer-arithmetic-error.feedback: Your inverse operation is correct, but the arithmetic with negative numbers is off.
integer-arithmetic-error.hint: Try the calculation on a number line, or substitute your answer back into the original equation.

fraction-error.label: Error multiplying fractions.
fraction-error.feedback: Your inverse operation is correct, but check your fraction multiplication.
fraction-error.hint: Multiply the numerators together and the denominators together, then simplify.

unrecognized.label: Incorrect step that matches no known misconception.
unrecognized.feedback: This line is not equivalent to the one before it.
unrecognized.hint: Compare this line to the previous one. Which inverse operation did you use, and did you use it on both sides?
